messages:
toni: Heads up: support found a handful of requests that got attributed to the wrong org in the console. Looks like the edge returned a stale X-Org on keep-alive connections. Repro below.

toni: repro:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer projless_omega123" -H "X-Request-ID: r-omega" \
  -H "X-Org: other-corp" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Edge response contains `X-Org: other-corp` but auth metadata owner=omega-corp. Console counts to other-corp.

max: This rings a bell. We introduced a fast-path for warmed connections that skips enrichment if the auth token was validated recently. That could let a previous header slip through.

leah: Short-term fix: strip inbound tenant headers at the ingress and have auth-service emit an internal owner header. Long-term we should prefer token-resolved owner for all telemetry.

toni: Agreed. Proposal: auth-service always emits `X-Internal-Owner: <org>` and signs it with an HMAC. Edge will strip client X-Org, validate HMAC, and populate `X-Telemetry-Owner`. Telemetry prefers X-Telemetry-Owner when present.

max: Perf note: this keeps the fast-path latency low since auth emitter runs where token is already validated. Edge validation is a cheap HMAC verify.

leah: Security: strip any incoming `X-Internal-Owner` or `X-Telemetry-Owner` headers from clients before enrichment. HMAC secret rotate must be supported and logged.

toni: Rollout plan: feature-flag `prefer_internal_owner` default off. Canary 5% internal traffic for 6h -> monitor `attribution_conflict_total`, `attribution_conflict_samples` (N request_ids + owners exported to S3) and quota deltas. If <0.05% conflicts and no quota drift, promote to sandbox (30% 24h) then global.

max: Add metric `attribution_conflict_total` increment when token-owner != observed-header-owner. Also add `attribution_delta_pct` per org so we can see impact.

leah: Console UX: add a small flag in request detail if owners differ: "owner(asserted): omega-corp | owner(observed): other-corp" with link to the sample log. Support can click to see raw headers and request_id.

toni: QA: add tests that attempt to spoof `X-Internal-Owner` and ensure edge validation rejects spoofed headers and falls back to token-owner. Also smoke test that console shows badge during canary.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved 2026-04-05 02:00-05:00 UTC. Oncall notified.

support-bot: support-notify: Notifying support channel about upcoming console badge and possible re-attribution during canary.

max: I'll open PR for edge changes + FF. Leah will handle auth-service header + HMAC and the telemetry team will wire the metrics. Toni will draft the rollout doc and console badge mock.

toni: Thanks. Let's reconvene after the first 6h canary to review `attribution_conflict_total` and decide go/no-go. :thumbsup:
